# 300.00 USD of travel charged to a US dollar card at 1.35, and 500.00 USD
# transferred from it to a second US dollar card at 1.40 — more than it owes.
#
# The first card goes from owing 300.00 to holding a credit of 200.00. So the
# first 300.00 of the transfer moves what is owed from one card to the other,
# which draws down no cost basis and opens none, and the other 200.00 is a
# borrowing: 200.00 more owed on the second card and 200.00 held on the first,
# each opening a cost basis at the 1.40 the transfer is stated at.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-01-20 * "Travel charged to the card"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Expenses:Travel 405.00 CAD
	Liabilities:USD Card -300.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
		value: "-405.00"

2034-02-01 * "Balance transfer of 500.00 USD from the card to card 2"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:USD Card 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "700.00"
	Liabilities:USD Card 2 -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-700.00"
